subject: Dyslexia Screening and Early Intervention
overview: The Medford School Committee received reports on the neuroscience of reading and the district's response to the Massachusetts dyslexia screening law, voting to evaluate alternative screeners before purchasing. The committee also honored student and teacher achievements in humanities and discussed student activity accounts and facility scheduling.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Financial Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes of April 8, 2019, alongside bills, payrolls, and fund transfers.

items.title: Recognition of Student Achievements in Humanities
items.summary: Honored middle and high school students for awards in the Model United Nations Conference, the Boston Duck Tour essay contest, and the NPR Student Podcast Challenge.

items.title: Recognition of MATSOL Teacher of the Year
items.summary: Congratulated Roberts Elementary teacher Christine Hingston on receiving the Massachusetts Association for Teachers of Speakers of Other Languages (MATSOL) Teacher of the Year Award.

items.title: Public Participation on Dyslexia Services
items.summary: Maureen Ronain described her family's struggles securing adequate reading support for her dyslexic son and urged the committee to prioritize structured literacy instruction and teacher training.

items.title: Report on the Science of Dyslexia
items.summary: Dr. Nadine Gaab delivered a presentation on neurobiological research, early childhood risk markers, and early screening; the committee voted to direct the administration to investigate costs for bringing in external dyslexia consulting programs.

items.title: Report on District Response to Dyslexia Screening Law
items.summary: Administrators reported on preparations for the state screening mandate and proposed piloting the Shaywitz Dyslexia Screen, but the committee voted to halt that purchase pending a cost analysis of other direct screening instruments.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reviewed recent school events and discussed the middle school lottery alongside plans to conduct a facilities feasibility study regarding middle school configurations.

items.title: Donation to Andrews Middle School Drama Club
items.summary: Approved a $150 donation from the Fitzpatrick family toward the Andrews Middle School musical.

items.title: Report on Student Activity Accounts and Facility Scheduling
items.summary: Staff presented an updated report on high school student activity accounts, prompting committee discussion on tracking outside fundraising organizations and consolidating district facility reservation calendars.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for the families of Ellen Gay, John Boyniak, and Anne Maloney.
